en.headline: Wang Fuk Court probe: discarded cigarette most likely ignited deadly blaze
en.dek: The inter-departmental investigation team’s final report, uploaded by the independent committee, finds the fire probably started when an unextinguished cigarette butt set alight construction debris on a Wang Cheong House podium.
body: The Independent Committee investigating the November 2025 Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po has made public the inter-departmental investigation team’s final report. The document concludes that the blaze most probably began when an unextinguished cigarette butt ignited paper boxes and other construction debris piled on the low-level podium outside units 104 and 105 of Wang Cheong House.

Investigators recovered two cigarette butts from the base of a two-metre-high pile of burnt residues that included safety-net fragments, polystyrene window boards, tile-backing paper and cardboard. Laboratory and electrical examinations ruled out accelerants, deliberate arson, electrical faults and LPG leakage. Tiling work was under way at the time; no welding or cutting operations were recorded.

Extremely dry conditions, with relative humidity between 40 and 50 per cent under a Red Fire Danger Warning, allowed the smouldering material to develop rapidly into open flame. Strong south-easterly winds and the estate’s re-entrant light wells then drove vertical fire spread via a chimney effect, while non-fire-retardant scaffolding nets and catch-fans contributed to further horizontal and secondary ignitions.

The report identifies five main factors behind the heavy casualties: rapid vertical spread that left residents almost no escape window; collapsed burning scaffolding blocking exits; failure of the fire-alarm system; foam boards covering windows that hid the outdoor fire; and dense smoke that rendered staircases and corridors untenable. The fire destroyed or severely damaged 562 units across six blocks and killed 168 people, including one firefighter.

zh.headline: 宏福苑跨部門最終報告：煙頭極可能引燃大火
zh.dek: 獨立委員會上載跨部門調查專組最終報告，指火勢極可能由未熄滅煙頭點燃宏昌閣平台堆積的建築雜物引起。
body: 大埔宏福苑大火獨立委員會周四晚上在網站上載跨部門調查專組的最終調查報告。報告指，大火起因極可能是未熄滅的煙頭點燃宏昌閣104及105室外低層平台堆積的紙箱及其他建築雜物。
調查人員在厚達兩米的燒焦殘骸底部檢獲兩支煙頭，同時發現防護網殘片、發泡膠窗遮板、磁磚背紙及大量紙箱。政府化驗所及機電工程署已排除助燃劑、縱火、電氣故障及石油氣洩漏的可能性。當時現場正進行鋪磁磚工程，並無燒焊作業。
事發當日紅色火災危險警告生效，相對濕度僅百分之40至50，極乾燥天氣令陰燃迅速演變成烈火。強勁東南風加上大廈凹槽的煙囪效應，令火勢沿外牆及光井急速垂直蔓延；非阻燃安全網及斜擋網則進一步助長橫向及二次點燃。
報告總結造成慘重傷亡的五大因素，包括凹槽效應令居民幾乎沒有逃生時間、燃燒竹棚堵塞出口、火警警報系統失效、發泡膠板遮擋窗戶，以及濃煙令樓梯及走廊迅速失守。大火共嚴重損毀562個單位，波及六座大廈，造成168人死亡，包括一名殉職消防人員。
